description: Transactions + consistency Phase-2 changes (plan items 4, 5, 6). Item 4: quick-filter chips above the Transactions list using the EXISTING filter path, and verify/legibility of the already-present per-day 'Spent' totals (add privacy masking only). Item 5: swipe-right quick-edit on history rows via an opt-in flag on the shared TransactionListCard (Home rows unaffected), plus a new quick-edit bottom sheet. Item 6: standardize Budgets' period control on PillChips to visually match Insights (no semantic merge). Independent of FEAT-001/002; runs last.
steps: Read context.json and this file FIRST, plus plan.md D4, D5, D6. Read transaction_history_screen.dart, transaction_row.dart, budget_list_screen.dart, insights_screen.dart, pill_chips.dart, app_sheets.dart, app_dropdown.dart.

Item 4 quick-filter chips: in transaction_history_screen.dart add a PillChips-based row directly below the search/filter Row and above `if (filter.hasAnyFilter) _ActiveFilterChips`. Build chips whose active state is derived from the current `filter`: [This month] active when filter.datePeriod == 'This Month', [Expenses] active when filter.type == 'expense', [Income] active when filter.type == 'income', optionally top 1-2 categories from categoriesListProvider (active when filter.categoryIds contains that id). Tapping an inactive chip applies via `ref.read(transactionListProvider.notifier).updateFilter((f) => f.copyWith(datePeriod: 'This Month'))` / `copyWith(type: 'expense')` / `copyWith(type: 'income')` / `copyWith(categoryIds: [id])`. Tapping an active chip clears it: `copyWith(clearDatePeriod: true, clearCustomDateRange: true)` / `copyWith(clearType: true)` / `copyWith(categoryIds: const [])`. Note PillChips is single-select by its `selected` string; here chips are independent toggles, so render them as a Row/Wrap of individual PillChip widgets (each with its own `selected` bool + onTap) rather than one PillChips group. Keep in sync with _ActiveFilterChips (same provider path).

Item 4 per-day totals: _DayHeader already renders 'Spent <amount>'. Do NOT add a second total. Only make it honor privacy masking: pass isMasked (from ref.watch(privacyModeProvider) in the build that constructs _DayHeader, i.e. compute it in the ConsumerState build and thread it into _DayHeader) into CurrencyFormatter.format(spent, isMasked: isMasked). No other change to the header.

Item 5 swipe-right flag: in transaction_row.dart add `final void Function(TransactionModel tx)? onQuickEdit;` to TransactionListCard and thread it into _buildRow. When onQuickEdit != null, set the Dismissible `direction: DismissDirection.horizontal`, add a startToEnd (left edge) teal 'Edit' background (use p.primary / a teal from palette, NOT a new token), and add `confirmDismiss: (dir) async { if (dir == DismissDirection.startToEnd) { onQuickEdit!(tx); return false; } return true; }` so a right-swipe opens the sheet without dismissing, while endToStart keeps the existing delete+undo via onDismissed/onDelete. When onQuickEdit == null (Home), keep the current endToStart-only Dismissible exactly (no behavior change).

Item 5 quick-edit sheet: create lib/presentation/widgets/transaction_quick_edit_sheet.dart — a function (e.g. showTransactionQuickEditSheet(context, ref, tx)) using AppBottomSheet.show that lets the user change category (reuse the add-form 6-chip grid pattern or AppDropdown<CategoryModel> fed by expenseCategoriesProvider/incomeCategoriesProvider by tx.type) and amount (a numeric TextField or showFieldsSheet-style field pre-filled with tx.amount). On save call `ref.read(transactionListProvider.notifier).updateTransaction(tx.copyWith(categoryId: <picked, non-null>, amount: <parsed>))` and AppHaptics.success(). NOTE: TransactionModel.copyWith cannot null categoryId, so quick-edit only sets a non-null category. Place the widget in lib/presentation/widgets/ consistent with existing shared widgets.

Item 5 wiring: in transaction_history_screen.dart pass `onQuickEdit: (tx) => showTransactionQuickEditSheet(context, ref, tx)` to the TransactionListCard used in _buildBody. Do NOT touch Home's TransactionListCard usage.

Item 6 unify control: in budget_list_screen.dart replace the period SegmentedTabs(options: ['Weekly','Monthly','Yearly'], selected: _period[0].toUpperCase()+_period.substring(1), onSelected: (label)=>setState(()=>_period=label.toLowerCase())) with PillChips using the SAME options/selected/onSelected. Remove the unused segmented_tabs.dart import if nothing else in the file uses it, and add pill_chips.dart import. Do not change options, default ('monthly'), or the budgets.where((b)=>b.period==_period) filtering. Leave Insights (already PillChips) unchanged.

Run dart format on all touched files; run flutter analyze (resolve any unused-import warnings from the item-6 swap) and flutter test (incl. transaction_filter_test, transaction_calculation_test). Stage ONLY the changed lib/ files by name (transaction_history_screen.dart, transaction_row.dart, transaction_quick_edit_sheet.dart, budget_list_screen.dart) and commit locally (e.g. 'feat(transactions): quick-filter chips, swipe-right quick-edit, unified range control'). Do not push. Record findings: the quick-edit sheet function signature and the onQuickEdit flag name.
acceptance_criteria: A quick-filter chip row (This month / Expenses / Income, optional top categories) sits below the search/filter row; each chip toggles exactly one filter via the existing updateFilter path, reflects active state from the current filter, and clears on re-tap, staying consistent with _ActiveFilterChips.
Per-day 'Spent' totals are not duplicated and now mask when privacy mode is on.
Swipe-left delete+undo still works on both Home and Transactions; swipe-right opens the quick-edit sheet ONLY on the Transactions history list; Home rows are unaffected.
The quick-edit sheet changes category and/or amount and persists via updateTransaction, refreshing the list.
Budgets' period control is now PillChips matching Insights, with identical options/semantics and working period filtering.
`flutter analyze` clean (no unused-import warnings); `flutter test` passes.
findings: Quick-edit sheet signature: Future<void> showTransactionQuickEditSheet(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref, TransactionModel tx) in lib/presentation/widgets/transaction_quick_edit_sheet.dart (sets non-null categoryId/categoryName + amount via transactionListProvider.notifier.updateTransaction, then AppHaptics.success). Opt-in swipe-right flag on TransactionListCard is named `onQuickEdit` (final void Function(TransactionModel tx)? onQuickEdit); when non-null the row's Dismissible uses direction horizontal with a teal p.primary left 'Edit' background and confirmDismiss returning false for startToEnd (opens sheet) while endToStart keeps the existing delete+undo. When null (Home) behaviour is unchanged (endToStart-only). flutter analyze clean; flutter test all passed.
